newsitem.title: USA: A.M. Best says upgrades EXEL to A-plus from A.
newsitem.headline: A.M. Best says upgrades EXEL to A-plus from A.

text.p: A.M. Best Co said Tuesday that it raised the rating on EXEL Ltd and its group members to A plus from A.
The A plus rating reflects the group's strong market position as one of the top providers of excess liability insurance coverage to Fortune 1000 companies around the world, A.M. Best said.

The group specializes in providing large policy limits on general liability, directors and officers, and professional liability insurance, along with specialty reinsurance products to large and complex business risks, A.M. Best said.
